summary: The visual consists of three charts analyzing payroll and losses over the years 1998 to 2007. The first bar chart shows payroll in millions of dollars, with a steady increase from 1998 to 2007, peaking in 2007. The second bar chart displays losses in thousands of dollars, with a significant decrease from 1998 to 2007, indicating improved financial management. The line chart illustrates losses per $1,000 of payroll, showing a sharp decline from $18.20 in 1998 to $0.30 in 2007, highlighting a substantial reduction in losses relative to payroll over the period.
